$comment: AIP-70 GLOSSARY vocabulary. `terms`: one meaning per term, its owning AIP, and what it never means. `deprecated`: aliases reported by scripts/check-names.mjs (report only).

terms.means: an agent binary driven by a host (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Hermes) and its manifest
terms.neverMeans: a bridge into a foreign framework; a session preset

terms.means: the projection of an agentproto handle into a foreign framework (Mastra, AI SDK)
an inward bridge from agentproto to an external API, CLI, MCP server or SDK
an agent holding a role in an organization
terms.neverMeans: the human who controls a host

terms.means: the human who owns and controls a host and its sessions
one running (or ended) harness invocation managed by a host
terms.neverMeans: a terminal, a browser instance, an ACP wire session (say "ACP session")

terms.means: how a session runs: harness, model, effort, posture, context, route, auth profile, retry, fallback
a named, saved session config
a backend endpoint a harness can be pointed at (Anthropic-compatible, OpenAI-compatible)
a named reference to the credential a session bills or authenticates through
terms.neverMeans: a context setting; a browser identity

terms.means: the builder of a model (the `vendor` in a `vendor/product` model id)
the party that serves and bills a model
the billing path a model is reached through (an `@<route>` suffix on a model id)
an AIP-38 access document: grants, limits, requirements
terms.neverMeans: a completion check, a retry rule, settings

terms.means: a check that passes or fails at a boundary: the delegation spawn gate of AIP-46, a completion check, a review verdict
what a session may do without asking (plan, accept-edits, bypass, read-only)
a harness-native, mutually exclusive operation profile declared in an AIP-45 manifest
terms.neverMeans: posture; a session lifetime; how a session is billed (billing basis); an action

terms.means: an AIP-47 organizational role (intent, never permission)
terms.neverMeans: an access role; a position; a model slot

terms.means: a permission tier of a human or agent (owner, admin, editor, viewer; for sessions, executor and supervisor)
a seat in an organization that one operator holds at a time
a logical model name resolved per host (review.small, judge.session)
a saved, ordered, declarative selection over a registry family
the in-memory catalog of handles of one family
the data a family's registry serves (model prices, context sizes)
an AIP-64 installable capability bundle
an AIP-57 map from a keyspace to targets
the AIP-48 multi-agent execution kernel
the daemon that runs sessions, runs and their state on a machine
an AIP-34 workspace node, including the `x.workspace` doctypes
the scratch directory a run gets
a PTY process driven through a host
terms.neverMeans: a session; the end state of a lifecycle (say "end state")

terms.means: one running browser driven through AIP-63
a saved browser login state
